title: Lior and the Radiators
author: Quentin Thornbury
blurb: Theo Villalobos, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
